purpose: Measure raw probability of the actually sampled token for an explicitly enabled ReBalance request, retaining the original controller and default path.
input_output_contract: Capture an owned FP32 logits snapshot before grammar, penalties and temperature; return p_raw(selected_id) for one sample per request. Default requests consume unchanged p_raw(max_id). Partial prefill samples never update controller history. Request content identity includes the opt-in flag.
failures_to_guard: Raw probability confused with temperature/top-p probability
Mixed/reordered requests use another request's confidence
Partial prefill or suspended KV replay double-counts tokens
Missing selected probabilities silently falls back to maximum
Disabled requests or cache fingerprints change implicitly
cheapest_checks: Extend existing vendor ReBalance tests for numerical snapshot, mixed state, serialized request identity and suspension behavior. Locally extract the actual functions with AST and run NumPy-backed checks, including the actual runner sample method with a mutating fake sampler; this does not substitute for Torch CPU/CUDA checks in the existing server environment. No dependency installation or model load locally. Prefix caching remains explicitly disabled, as in every current research runner; vector-slot fingerprints do not encode the entire dynamic history and are not a promise of safe dynamic KV sharing.
GPU_gate: The already fixed sampled_confidence_20260912 plan first requires saved-answer probability replay to pass the opportunity threshold. Online generation is conditional; new runtime code alone does not qualify it.
scope: Only original algorithm=rebalance, arithmetic confidence, no negative-only, radial or feedback combinations. Existing defaults stay false. No extra graph family, hidden-state transform or calibration regeneration.
